title: Adam Vinatieri pokes fun at Bill Belichick in Hall of Fame speech

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Adam Vinatieri pokes fun at Bill Belichick in Hall of Fame speech
sources.description: Former Patriots and Colts kicker Adam Vinatieri entered the Hall of Fame on the same day that former Patriots and Browns coach Bill Belichick should have been getting his own bronze bust.
